examples.Paper2Fig_arch_diff_000000021: We observe that the Hopping Bounding Box starts out on a combined grouping of the Facial Feature Extractor and Person Dictionary. Also, from the examination of the XML it is clear that the edit has grouped the two modules, allowing them to be animated together.
examples.CBD_flow_000000015: In this case, since only 1 number was entered, the diagram correctly follows the “Yes” branch and prints the output.
examples.CBD_flow_000000079: We can see that the correct branch corresponding to the given case is correctly animated, using the animation style of Colour Pop.
examples.CBD_flow_000000145: Given a case where the guessed number is 45, the animation sequence follows the correct traversal path along the flowchart and applies the animation style to it.
examples.DocFigures_arch_000000173: We can see that the branch to the Count Constraint module is correctly removed from the diagram.
examples.FigureBench_arch_diff_000000253: On the left we have the Detail-first traversal style for the diagram and on the right we have the Overview-first traversal style for the same diagram.
examples.Paper2Fig_pipe_diff_000000475: We can see that, as per the instructions, the animation only progressively reveals the Model Testing block.
examples.Papers_with_code_arch_000000325: We can see that, as per the instructions, the Cardinal 1 … Cardinal K block is incrementally animated as requested.
examples.arch_arxiv_ai_2025_000000102: We can see that the “Physics Perception Layer” and “Reasoning & Diagnosis Layer” are animated in detail, whereas the “Detection and Attribution Layer” module is animated in one shot.
